edition: Employment Allowance take-up statistics: 2024 to 2025 tax year estimates
published_note: Cover_Sheet: 'The data tables in this spreadsheet were originally published at 9:30am 25 June 2025.' The next publication was due June 2026.
columns: 2024 to 2025 tax year: Employers benefitting from EA
2024 to 2025 tax year: % of EA beneficiaries
method: Every figure was read from the downloaded workbook on the access date by tools/extract_uk_firm_employment_allowance_takeup.py; none was filled from memory. Counts are as published, rounded by HMRC to the nearest 1,000, with thousands separators removed; shares are whole percent as published. Labels are whitespace-normalised (the region sheet's 'Total ' code loses its trailing space). An employer counts as benefitting when some allowance was offset against its employer NICs paid to HMRC (Cover_Sheet). Codes as published: GSS E12 codes for the English regions and HMRC's W99999999, S99999999 and N99999999 for Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland. Region is the claiming enterprise's postcode in the ONS Business Lookup Table (94% match rate); unmatched cases were apportioned by HMRC.
